=== DOCS-TRUTH VERIFIED (2026-06-08 via WebFetch trino.io/docs/467/functions/array.html) ===
• `slice(x, start, length) -> array` — Trino 467 verbatim: 'Subsets array x starting from index start (or starting from the end if start is negative) with a length of length.'
• Start is 1-BASED (consistent with element_at and the [] subscript). Negative start counts from the END. Length is element-COUNT (not end-index); clamps silently if fewer elements remain.
• `array_slice` is NOT documented in Trino 467 — verified absent from the array-functions reference. Parse-fails.
• `array_sort(array(T), function(T, T, int)) -> array(T)` 2-arg comparator form: VALID. Comparator returns -1/0/1. Documented descending form is `(x, y) -> IF(x < y, 1, IF(x = y, 0, -1))`; the 2-branch shorthand `(a, b) -> IF(a > b, -1, 1)` used in the FIX-A example is the common descending-sort shorthand and produces an equivalent descending order.
